blocks.text: The management of P-pop boy group ECHO set the record straight on the death of its member Sphere, urging the public to refrain from spreading unverified information about his demise. The management issued a reminder through a statement released on its Facebook page on Tuesday, Oct. 6, a day after the death of the singer—whose real name is Jaspher Cabangon—was confirmed. “A gentle reminder to everyone: As requested by Sphere’s family, we kindly ask everyone to refrain from making assumptions, speculating, or spreading unverified information regarding the cause of his passing,” it said. “To clarify, Sphere did not die by suicide, […]...
